about_the_game:
Beatfinder is an upcoming 3-button rhythm runner.

The goal of the game is to time jumps, slides, and kicks to get past the obstacles in a seamless flow. Each music track defines the level, with handcrafted timing for obstacles and actions.

Select a Music score you want to play!

Jump, slide and kick to the Beat of your favourite song!

Beat the highest score!

Create your own levels!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or later
  • Processor: 1.8Ghz Intel® Core 2 Duo or faster
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 780
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or later
  • Processor: 2.66Ghz Intel® Core 2 Duo or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required

short_description: Jump, slide and kick to the rhythm of the music! In this side scrolling runner game you control a fantasy hero as they dash across the rooftops of a city swarming with cultists.
